title: sclerochloa procumbens
intro: Sclerochloa procumbens, commonly known as creeping bentgrass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and relieving coughs. The therapeutic actions of Sclerochloa procumbens include its antispasmodic and expectorant properties, which help to relax the muscles and promote the removal of mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of Sclerochloa procumbens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
